samples.summary: Clear formatting at a link's trailing edge no longer lets typed text escape the hyperlink
samples.evidence: `clearFormatting()`'s collapsed-caret branch now stages `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE`, which no longer carries `href: undefined` (types.ts:300-315). `pending.set` *replaces* the staged style (pending-style.ts:22-24) and `consumeForInsert` applies it as a merge patch over the newly typed run (pending-style.ts:34-41); with no `href` key the patch cannot remove one. Insertion itself inherits the surrounding run's style (`applyInsertText`, block-helpers.ts:117-146), so a caret sitting flush after a hyperlink + Cmd+\ + typing an ordinary character now silently extends the link. The repo's link-exit machinery (`isAtLinkTrailingEdge` / `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge`, text-editor.ts:5891-5923) only fires for space, Enter and paste — for plain typed characters the old `href: undefined` in the clear payload was the only escape hatch, and the toolbar path is worse: `editor.ts:1170` merges the raw caret style (which includes `href`) *under* CLEAR, explicitly staging the link. Neither the diff nor the design-doc update mentions this trailing-edge regression.

samples.summary: `removeLink` cannot replace the bulk unlink that Clear formatting used to provide
samples.evidence: The new doc comments (types.ts:292-298, editor.ts:99-100, text-box-editor.ts:268-269) justify keeping `href` by pointing at `removeLink` as the separate command. But `removeLink` (editor.ts:3696-3714) reads only `cursor.position`, resolves a single `findLinkRunAt` run in a single block, and ignores `selection.range` entirely; the text-box version is the same shape. So the previous 'select all → Clear formatting strips every link' capability now has no replacement: a document with N links needs N separate caret placements, and a link inside a selection spanning several blocks cannot be removed at all without moving the caret into each one. The new tests only cover the caret-inside-one-link case (editor-clear-formatting.test.ts 'removeLink is still how a hyperlink is dropped'), which hides the gap.
searchedFor: grep clearInlineFormatting call sites in packages/frontend

samples.summary: Collapsed-caret Clear formatting stages the caret's structural keys (`image`/`pageNumber`) into pending, defeating the omission the new comment relies on
samples.evidence: The updated `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` comment argues `image`/`pageNumber` are omitted so a clear never grafts them, but the toolbar's collapsed path builds `pending.set({ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style })` — the raw caret style first. A caret resolved onto an image or page-number run (caret-style.ts:72-80 returns that run's style verbatim) therefore stages `image`/`pageNumber`, and `consumeForInsert` re-applies them over the freshly typed text *after* `applyInsertText` deliberately stripped them (block-helpers.ts:136-141), producing a text run painted as an image / replaced by the page number. Pre-existing (it affects `applyStyle` too) but it is exactly the grafting the diff's rationale claims is prevented, so the invariant as documented does not hold on this path.

verdict.reason: The mechanism is present as described (CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE omits href at types.ts:300-315; pending.set replaces and consumeForInsert merge-patches at pending-style.ts:22-41; resolveOffset/applyInsertText append into the preceding link run at block-helpers.ts:24-41,117-146; exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge is wired only for space/Enter/paste at text-editor.ts:981,2608,2641,4154), so typed text at a link's trailing edge does keep the href. But this is the change's explicitly specified contract, not a logic/runtime defect: types.ts:283-299 documents href as a content attribute preserved by Clear formatting (issue #1051, Word parity, removeLink as the separate command), and docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md:248-271 covers this exact case ("The collapsed-caret path stages the same constant on the pending style, so a caret follows whatever a range would have done" — a range write over a linked run keeps href). The task's acceptance criteria demand this behavior. No crash, data loss, race, swallowed error, or inconsistent state results; the toolbar and shortcut paths agree in outcome (editor.ts:1170 stages href explicitly, the shortcut inherits it). The remaining inability to type a plain character flush after a link is the pre-existing, documented scope of the link-exit machinery (link-trailing-edge.test.ts:7-17: Enter/Space only), i.e. a product/design question for another lens, not a correctness bug in this lane.
